scope: Requested seasons 20252026 and 20262027; season-window composite rows, scheduled games, and the latest observed ALL-strength rolling date

composites.query: select season_id,strength_state,window_type,window_size,peer_group_type,peer_group_key,max(snapshot_date) as latest_snapshot,count(*) as rows,count(mcm_score) as available_mcm_rows,count(distinct player_id) as players from public.skater_composite_ratings where season_id in (20252026,20262027) and window_type='season' group by season_id,strength_state,window_type,window_size,peer_group_type,peer_group_key order by season_id,strength_state,peer_group_type,peer_group_key
absentRequestedContexts: ALL strength for both requested seasons

scheduledGames.query: select "seasonId",type,min(date) as first_scheduled_date,max(date) as last_scheduled_date,count(*) as scheduled_games,count(*) filter(where date>'2026-04-16' and "seasonId"=20252026) as games_after_ranking_snapshot from public.games where "seasonId" in (20252026,20262027) group by "seasonId",type order by "seasonId",type

latestDailyRollingRows.query: select snapshot_date,count(*) as rows,count(distinct game_id) as games,count(distinct player_id) as players,min(game_date) as first_game_date,max(game_date) as last_game_date from (select game_date as snapshot_date,game_date,game_id,player_id from public.rolling_player_game_metrics where season=20252026 and strength_state='all' and game_date='2026-04-16') latest group by snapshot_date

limits: Non-null MCM counts do not certify finite values, minimum-sample eligibility, scoring-component coverage or statistical stability.
Scheduled-game counts do not prove completed-game ingestion or per-player denominator completeness.
The last daily rolling date is not the all-season player population; the consumer also searches earlier dates.
The earlier generic entity_metric_rankings receipt does not describe the actual skater_composite_ratings publisher.
No publisher, migration, recompute, data write or deployment was invoked.
